summary: The PR doubles the overdue fine rate from the required 25 cents to 50 cents per completed day and changes tests to enforce that contradictory behavior. No source-of-truth documents are modified.

findings.message: Changing FINE_PER_DAY_CENTS to 50 contradicts openspec/specs/fines/spec.md, which requires 25 cents per completed overdue 24-hour period. This overcharges members before the cap, reaches caps prematurely, and can cause premature fine-related suspension and checkout rejection.

Updated assertions enforce the unsupported 50-cent daily rate rather than the specified 25-cent rate. The premium boundary test also replaces the required 19/20/21-day expectations of 475/500/500 cents with a 9/10/11-day cap boundary. Related changes in test/holds.test.ts and test/renewals.test.ts likewise encode the contradictory rate.
